messages:
maria: Heads-upI opened a migration PR to refresh the Quickstart for v2 SDKs. Goal: keep the hello-world tiny, fix TS/JS async examples, and make the auth check explicit. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2389 :sparkles:

devid: quick scan looks good overall. Two things: TS example uses old callback style; convert to async/await and show types. Also the README link at the top is 404we should point to the new starter repo.

oliver: I'll take the typescript fix. Also the curl health check still shows a bearer literal. Replace with $REDWOOD_API_KEY and add `curl -I` example to just check headers/status.

charlie: For the deploy snippet, we have `--no-wait` which hides failure output in CI. Recommend removing it and adding a note: "omit --no-wait in CI; only use for local fast iteration."

maria: Agreed on all. I'll swap the README link and drop --no-wait. Anyone want the tiny Dedicated vs Hosted paragraph? Might help new users choose.

anita: I'll draft a two-sentence callout: "Hosted is fastest for prototyping; Dedicated is for steady production traffic or data isolation. Check costs and region availability in Console." Keep it short.

devin: Also add one-line auth verification post-export: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...` then `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` expecting 200. Super handy for onboarding.

oliver: pushed TS/JS patch to the branch (oliver/ts-async). Replaced old callbacks with `await client.generate(...)` and fixed types in the example. Kept snippet under 18 lines per request.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #2389 running markdown-check, link-check, snippet-lint. ETA ~3m. :robot_face:

charlie: minor: Dockerfile note for mac users permissions on build context can fail if files created as root. Add `chown` note or run with `--user` in the Docker example.

maria: Good catch. I'll add the permission recommendation and an explicit `expected time: 10-20m` at the top of the quickstart.

anita: added the Dedicated vs Hosted blurb in a follow-up commit. Kept it neutral and linked to the product comparison page.

docs-bot: lint results: markdown OK, link-check found 1 broken link (fixed by maria), snippet-lint: 1 warning (console.debug left in JS example). Details: https://ci.internal.redwood/2389

devin: removed console.debug and pushed. Also added the one-line auth verification command to the troubleshooting section.

oliver: verified examples locally TS/JS run, python works (anita's async variant). Docker note tested on mac.

charlie: LGTM, approving. :white_check_mark:

anita: approved.

docs-bot: PR #2389 merged by maria release note: docs: quickstart migration v2 (TS async, auth check, deploy fixes) deploy job queued.

maria: Thanks! Will watch the deploy job and post in #docs if anything needs a quick follow-up. Maybe schedule a 15m doc-polish next week to catch any small wording issues. :coffee:
